title: Moving machines without losing their contents

blocks.text: Use the wrench deliberately. A normal face use cycles side modes. Sneak-use dismantles a supported machine while preserving its inventory, FE and settings when the relevant preservation options are enabled.

rows: Stop input automation and let the current batch finish or pause it.
Check pending results and external connections.
Sneak-use the wrench and confirm that exactly one machine item was returned.
Place it again and compare inventory, charge, side settings and module contents.
Recheck owner/protection status at the new site before restarting world-changing actions.

blocks.text: Breaking a multi-block machine extension removes the owning controller structure rather than creating independent copies of each section. When testing a new release, use a copied world before moving valuable machinery.
